_publications._context: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived from an individual with NF1 (blood, EBV-transformed with cyclosporin A per Anderson & Gusella 1984). Carries NF1 variant c.4970A>C, substitution in exon 36 (28) (p.Y1657S), a missense substitution. Clinical data are available for this individual. Synapse syn74552629; James Walker's group, Massachusetts General Hospital.

basicInfo.description: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived via EBV transformation from the blood of an individual with NF1, carrying the NF1 variant c.4970A>C (p.Y1657S) (Substitution in exon 36 (28)).
